description:
Planet X and SPHEREx. We’ll build a public web tool that shows NASA SPHEREx sky images over time and automatically highlights objects that move between images, like asteroids, comets and maybe even new planets. I’ll lead the web app and the data pipeline.

Why join us: we’re focused on building a real working demo, not just slides. That’s what the winning teams in Tashkent did last year. You’ll learn real astronomy data processing, computer vision and web development.
